title: Interpreter and editor

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
The interpreter runs instructions and the editor helps write them; installing an editor does not install Python.
CORE EXPLANATION
The interpreter executes Python source; an editor helps write and organize a project. Start with a lightweight editor or IDE, then verify the path of the Python interpreter it selected.

COMMON MISTAKES
Keep the interpreter, pip, and project packages in the same virtual environment.
